title: Finally done building this database — time to actually put it to use
author: bossman94949
selftext:
Took about 2 months, but finally at a point where I'm happy calling this done. A personal financial database covering US, China, India, and international equities, FX and crypto down to the minute, futures, macro, 13F institutional holdings, COT positioning, all in one place. Went through a proper cleanup pass too — fixed some real bugs along the way (broken split adjustments, survivorship bias, some duplicate data) instead of just piling more data on top.

What's in it:

|Asset Class|Coverage|Range|Granularity|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|US Equities|353 tickers|1927–2026|Daily|
|China Equities|4,049 tickers|2000–2026|Daily|
|India Equities|3,036 tickers|1999–2026|Daily|
|International Equities|556 tickers|1986–2026|Daily|
|FX (majors)|6 pairs|2000–2026|1-min|
|Crypto|BTC/ETH/SOL|2012–2026|1-min|
|Futures|542 contracts|1959–2026|Mixed|
|COT Positioning|1,097 markets|1986–2026|Weekly|
|13F Institutional Holdings|13,109 filers|1987–2026|Quarterly|
|Macro|US/UK/EU/Japan + global|1854–2026|Varies|
|Volatility|VIX, MOVE, SKEW, etc.|1990–2026|Daily|
|Earnings|496 tickers|2008–2026|Quarterly|
|Factor Returns|Fama-French factors|1926–2026|Daily|

\~422M rows, \~34GB total.

Honestly just happy to have it in a state I actually trust now. No more excuses — time to stop building and start testing real ideas on it. Curious to see what actually holds up.
